ordered_branches.explanation: NOLOCK lookup captures parent and receipt. Updates target status/stamp/UTC time, then while parent>0 sets parent status to MIN child status and advances to parent PARENT. No visited-set/cycle guard; missing positive ancestor leaves assignment unchanged and may loop. MIN ignores NULL child statuses and can return NULL. Calls RTH_UpdateHeader after chain; missing starting container still reaches child with NULL receipt. No warehouse restriction or atomic transaction.
